annotation.title_clean: 产业技术基础公共服务平台管理办法
annotation.title_en: Measures for the Administration of Industrial Technology Foundation Public Service Platforms
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 工业和信息化部 (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT)
annotation.summary_en: MIIT measures (Gong Xin Bu Ke [2025] No. 261, effective 5 December 2025) governing the application, review, operation and dynamic evaluation of public service platforms providing metrology, testing, standards verification, certification and IP services across key industries. AI, metaverse and brain-computer interfaces are listed only as service sectors. Replaces the 2015 interim measures.
key_provisions_or_claims: Voluntary application, provincial recommendation, MIIT expert review and public listing of platforms
Eligibility criteria: legal entity, 50+ staff, equipment or revenue over 10 million yuan
Annual evaluation and triennial comprehensive review; failing platforms are delisted
Delisting and three-year bar for fraud, serious accidents or violations
Replaces the 2015 interim measures, effective 5 December 2025
